_comment: OPERATOR: this is a short starter list of plain profanity only. Replace `words` with the full LDNOOBW English list (the `en` file of the repository named in `source`, one entry per line, CC-BY 4.0) before a public run. Entries are matched as whole words or phrases after lowercasing, NFKC, diacritic stripping and leet substitution, so write them in plain lowercase letters. Do not add slurs by hand; take them from the list. An entry starting with `re:` is a regexp rule (Elasticsearch regexp syntax, lowercase, matched against single analysed tokens) used only by the percolator index; the in-process fallback skips it. After editing, run `node scripts/moderation-rules.mjs --reload-rules` so the deployed rules change too; the server's fallback list changes on its next start.
